_comment: Three defects. (1) The trigger was ON_ENTER_PLAY, which fires on ARENA entry -- an arsenal is not the arena, so the ability never fired at all; ON_PUT_FACEUP_IN_ARSENAL is the trigger for exactly this wording. (2) LOOK_AT defaults its `player` to OPPONENT, so a card saying "the top of YOUR deck" peeked at the opponent's -- not a dead effect but an information leak in the wrong direction. The look is optional ("you MAY look").
